title: DSA for Tier-1 Interviews
description: The patterns that crack Tier-1 coding rounds: complexity analysis, two-pointers & sliding window, hashing/stacks/heaps, linked lists/trees/tries, graphs (BFS/DFS, topological sort, union-find, Dijkstra), and recursion/backtracking/DP — each a judged, pytest-graded problem you solve under a timer.
